messages:
maria: kicking off a config-only canary for inference-service at 18:00 UTC — changing routing weight and batching params. change window 18:00-19:00. I’ll post release notes link shortly.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] initiating canary deploy: service=inference-service, change=cfg-2026-03-21-railings, target=5% traffic. rollout_id=rl-8921. docs: https://redwood.dev/rl/rl-8921

chetan: ack. watching p95/p99 and error-rate. thresholds: p99>200ms OR error_rate>0.8% => roll back.

nguyen: please pin tenant:payments to previous routing for the window (customers with strict SLOs). I’ll patch the tenant-exclude list.

maria: done — payments pinned. also toggled extra tracing for canary.

deploy-bot: canary at 5% applied at 18:06 UTC. observe: batching.default_size=8 -> sent as 8 (was 4).

chetan: quick check: seeing small queuing bump on a subset of replicas. p95 ~130ms, p99 ~210ms for a few pods.

sre-oncall: noted. 210ms p99 breaches our trigger. prepping rollback steps now.

nguyen: can we try reducing batch_size to 6 instead of full rollback? might reduce kv-cache pressure.

maria: can we do a micro-config update w/o re-deploy? yes, config-only should be hot. will push batch_size=6 and keep routing weight.

maria: applying hot-config update: {
  "service": "inference-service",
  "batching": {"default_size": "6"},
  "note": "temporary microtune during canary"
}

deploy-bot: hot-config applied at 18:12 UTC. canary still 5%. rollout_id=rl-8921 (update-1).

chetan: after change: p95 ~125ms, p99 ~205ms — marginal improvement but still flirting with threshold. error-rate stable at 0.2%.

sre-oncall: p99 still >200ms on two pods, but error-rate is low. recommendation: rollback to previous config to be safe. initiating rollback in 2m unless objections.

nguyen: no objections from infra side. payments still pinned.

maria: ok go ahead — prefer safe rollback and re-evaluate batching policy in staging.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] rollback started at 18:17 UTC. reverting cfg-2026-03-21-railings -> previous stable.

deploy-bot: rollback complete at 18:18:42 UTC. traffic and batching params reverted. rollback_id=rb-4432.

chetan: confirming: p99 back to ~115ms, error-rate normal. queues cleared.

sre-oncall: good. leaving the tenant pin for payments in place for one more hour.

maria: creating a short release note and action items: 1) tune batching profiles in staging w/ KV cache stress test; 2) consider ramp plan that reduces batch_size on first 10% then grows; 3) add an automatic microtune rollback if p99>180ms (safer margin).

nguyen: I’ll open an infra ticket to add the gradual batch ramp and an exclusion list UI for quick pins.

maria: thanks — will also attach canary logs and the small config diff to the ticket. closing the thread once notes are in the release doc. :white_check_mark:
